review: Independent source review of the continuous narration and original music revision
method: Inspected the script, cues, current WAV headers and hashes, generator source, composition audio elements, carve metadata and scene source. Checked current independent voice verification. No listening, ASR transcript check or final encoded MP4 inspection is claimed here.
script: Looks ready to ship, right? You change a setting, close the dialog, and jump straight back to work. Until one tiny bug makes your next move a guessing game. Focus Trail follows your keyboard journey, spots where it breaks, and helps you catch the problem before your users do.
storyArc: A shipping question invites the viewer into an apparently polished interface.
A familiar setting-dialog scenario establishes the intended return to work.
One small bug turns the next move into uncertainty.
Focus Trail follows the keyboard journey and points to the break.
The developer is invited to catch the problem before users meet it.

continuousDelivery.synthesis: One complete paragraph in one synthesis result.
continuousDelivery.pauses: Three measured sentence pauses of about 0.57–0.60 seconds remain. No scene-boundary gaps or stitched scene takes are authored. Continuity does not mean removal of ordinary breathing and punctuation.
continuousDelivery.normalization: Two-pass loudness normalization and 24-to-48 kHz resampling preserve exact native duration. Padding is confined to the trailing normalization guard; no internal silence is inserted.
continuousDelivery.expressivenessLimit: Story, paragraph-level performance and forward-moving language support the requested energetic delivery. Perceived naturalness and energy are subjective and were not established by this source review.

timing.method: Composition offset plus Kokoro predicted phoneme/token timings; estimates, not independently recognized speech.
timing.interpretation: The continuous story bridges scene cuts. The twist anticipates the controlled-fault journey, while the diagnostic payoff continues into the saved report. It is not presented as a timestamped narration of each key or outcome.

music.provenance: Generator constructs oscillators and noise directly; the original composition, source WAV and code have an included MIT license. No third-party recordings or samples are inputs.

authoredRelease.description: Retains the canonical spectral carve and speech-time gain envelope. The music level rises by 6.66 dB from the first encode; the gain duck releases to 0 dB after the complete voice ends, before the source music fade from 19.25 to 20 seconds.

music.limit: Carve settings establish intended speech clearance. Actual encoded inclusion and signal levels require the separate render-audio evidence; no listening claim is made.

factualScope.controlledDemonstration: A controlled dialog keyboard-focus regression, not proof that every accessibility issue is detected or that independent installations have occurred.
factualScope.settingScenario: Changing a setting and returning to work supplies the scenario. The captured demonstration verifies dialog focus behavior and does not establish that a setting was saved.
factualScope.freshFocusObservation: The broken-flow capture and visible inspector separately show Document body after Escape.
factualScope.savedReport: The historical report marks return-opener missing after 500 ms and retains its last coherent sample. The endpoint-sample-unavailable caveat remains visible; the narration does not claim this report freshly sampled BODY.
factualScope.closing: Catch the problem before your users do is an invitation to test, not a guarantee of bug-free releases.

limits: No subjective listening or ASR transcript validation.
Final video and rendered mix are reviewed separately after rendering.
Spoken narration.srt matches all 49 words in 9 ordered phrases. Its timings use model estimates, not ASR. captions.srt represents the visible UI captions rather than a transcript of the voice.
